title: Family Birthday at Dining Table, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Joe, Gary, Mark, Aunt Clara Gary 3 yrs old Sept 17, 1954
description: A 1954 black-and-white family snapshot depicting Joe, 3-year-old Gary, Mark, and Aunt Clara around a decorated dining table with a small birthday cake and milk bottle. Set in a mid-century American dining nook with floral leaf wallpaper.
